bio.content: Dance Gavin Dance is an experimental post-hardcore band formed in Sacramento, California, United States in 2005, out of the ashes of Farewell Unknown and Left Apart. The band is well known for their relatively frequent lineup changes, which, most notably, involves a fluctuating lineup of vocalists, both on tour and on record. Dance Gavin Dance incorporates many different musical genres into their palette, such as math rock, progressive rock, funk, and soul on top of its post-hardcore sound. Ex-vocalist Jonny Craig also received high marks for contributing to the band's unorthodox soul sound and guitarist Will Swan has been recognized for his intricate, fast-moving guitar licks and riffs. Discography: November 14, 2006 - Whatever I Say Is Royal Ocean May 15, 2007 - Downtown Battle Mountain August 19, 2008 - Dance Gavin Dance June 9, 2009 - Happiness October 18, 2010 - Live At Bamboozle 2010 (Live album) March 8, 2011 - Downtown Battle Mountain II March 8, 2011 - People You Knew / Perfect (Single) October 8, 2013 - Acceptance Speech September 17, 2014 - Pussy Vultures (Single) April 14, 2015 - Instant Gratification May 13, 2016 - Tree City Sessions (Live album) October 7, 2016 - Mothership June 15, 2017 - Summertime Gladness (Single) June 8, 2018 - Artificial Selection March 22, 2019 - Head Hunter (Single) August 30, 2019 - Acceptance Speech 2.0 (Remastered) October 11, 2019 - Blood Wolf (Single) April 24, 2020 - Afterburner December 25, 2020 - Tree City Sessions 2 (Live album) July 29, 2022 - Jackpot Juicer August 24, 2023 - The Ghost Of Billy Royalton (Single) October 24, 2023 - War Machine (Single) May 10, 2024 - Speed Demon / "Straight From The Heart (Single) September 12, 2025 - Pantheon May 22, 2026 - Tree City Sessions 3 (Live album) All of Dance Gavin Dance's records have been released on Rise Records. Band members: Jonathan Mess - unclean vocals (2005–2008; 2010–present), additional clean vocals (2025–present) Will Swan - guitars (2005–present); unclean vocals (2008–2010), rap vocals (2009–present), bass guitar (2022-present) Matt Mingus - drums (2005–present) Andrew Wells - guitars, clean vocals, bass guitar (2021-present; touring 2015-2021), lead vocals (2022, 2024–present) Touring members: Sergio Medina - rhythm guitar, bass guitar (touring 2021-present) Martin Bianchini - guitar (session 2015–present; touring 2024–present) Former Members: Jonny Craig – clean vocals (2005–2007; 2010–2012; touring 2015, 2016) Kurt Travis – clean & unclean vocals (2007–2010; touring 2012, 2015, 2016) Alvaro Alcala – guitar (2005-2006) Sean O'Sullivan – guitar (2006–2007; touring 2010) Zachary Garren – guitar (2007–2010; touring 2015) Josh Benton - guitar (2010-2014) Eric Lodge – bass guitar (2005–2008; 2010–2012) Jason Ellis – bass guitar (2008–2009) Tim Feerick – bass guitar (2009–2010; 2012–2022; died 2022) Tilian Pearson - clean vocals (2012–2024) Former touring members: Matt Geise – clean vocals (2012) Dan Snook – guitar (2010) Aric Garcia - guitar (2014-2015) Alex Whitcomb - guitar (2015) Tony Marks – bass guitar (2010) Jordan McCoy – bass guitar (2011–2012) Read more on Last.fm.
